EmailTemplate.subject: ASU MS Biochemistry (Medicinal Chemistry) Information
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in graduate programs within the School of Molecular Sciences at Arizona State University. The MS in biochemistry with a concentration in medicinal chemistry is not accepting applications at this time, except for current ASU undergraduate students as an accelerated BS/MS degree in conjunction with select BS degree programs. We do not offer any other Master’s degrees and are only admitting students to our PhD programs; I encourage you to consider applying if you are interested.
If you are a current ASU student and are interested in the accelerated BS/MS in medicinal chemistry, please contact me directly to set up an appointment to discuss the program in more detail.
The School of Molecular Sciences offers PhD degrees in both chemistry and biochemistry, and all admitted students are fully funded, including the cost of tuition, health insurance and a competitive stipend.
Applications are accepted for study beginning in fall semesters only. The application will be available beginning September 1 for admission to the following fall and the application deadline is January 1. We do not admit students for the spring semester. The application is made up of two parts: a general graduate application through the graduate admissions office and a supplemental application to the School of Molecular Sciences.
We are a growing program that is conducting cutting edge, interdisciplinary research to solve societal problems at the molecular level, and I encourage you to check out the research being conducted by our faculty. I hope you will consider joining us.
If you have questions about the application process or graduate programs that are not included on our website, please email me and I will be happy to assist you.
Good luck in your pursuit of graduate studies.
David Nutt Graduate Programs Coordinator School of Molecular Sciences smsgrad@asu.edu 480-965-4664 {!Case.Thread_Id}
